metadata.description: Claude Code skills and plugins for day-to-day dev work: side panes, session stats, time tracking, manual test plans, and a ticket-to-PR workflow.

plugins.name: desk
plugins.description: A work pane for the branch you're on: its GitHub issue and acceptance criteria, its PR's checks and reviews, your local dev services, and a where-you-left-off note.

plugins.name: session-stats
plugins.description: A live pane of session stats (tokens, prompt cache, usage limits, cost, tools, agents) with alerts, a done notification, and cache-tax's keepwarm and cold-send guard.

plugins.name: log-time
plugins.description: Log a day's work to Harvest from the tickets in your git commits and GitHub PRs.

plugins.name: manual-test-plan
plugins.description: Build a manual test plan for the ticket you're on, as a web page to tick through: cases written from the spec, not the code, with real records from your local database.

plugins.name: next
plugins.description: Orient on an epic: what's in flight, what's takeable, what's blocked, and the one thing to do next. Read-only.

plugins.name: prep-branch
plugins.description: Start a ticket: put you on a branch cut from the latest trunk, with nothing in the way, and take the ticket (assign it, and move its board card to In progress).

plugins.name: gate
plugins.description: Run your project's CI checks locally against the staged change, and check it against the ticket's acceptance criteria.

plugins.name: commit-pr
plugins.description: Commit the staged change and open a PR in the repo's own style, then move the tickets to In review and tick their met acceptance criteria.

plugins.name: pr-comments
plugins.description: Work a PR's unresolved review threads end to end: assess each finding, fix the agreed ones, then reply and resolve.
